about: cc-capsule-identity lab falsifiers (tasks 001, 005, 003, 009, 004, 007, 013, 014, 011, 012, 015, 016, 017, 018, 019, 020, 025 and 023). Each one plants a bug in the lab CID harness (src/lib.rs), a fixture manifest, the wc-001 test driver, the fresh-key helper, the run of README's Python rule, the Cargo-based consumer scan or the claim scan of the lane's docs and code (tests/common/mod.rs), the lane .gitignore or README.md, and requires every named test to FAIL for its own reason, never from a build error. command is "capsule-identity" and file paths are relative to examples/agent-host/, so a lane file is ../../lab/capsule-identity/... . The canonical runner runs them: python3 -I examples/agent-host/falsify.py --from lab/capsule-identity/falsifiers.json (its capsule-identity command builds and tests lab/capsule-identity/Cargo.toml).
